description: A tiny completed scientific objective badge for Mars Crafts. ONE large clear bright cyan green check mark inside a compact dark navy sci-fi confirmation badge, tiny white metallic corner accents. The check is the dominant simple unambiguous shape. Extremely readable 16x16 GBA pixel art UI, 6 to 10 colors, clean dark outline, crisp square pixels. Centered isolated independent icon with 2px transparent margin all sides. Transparent background, no letters, no text, no other symbols, no environment, no big panel.

style_image.usage_description: Existing Mars Crafts art reference: preserve palette, clean pixel detail, outline, lighting and object identity as described. Do not reproduce reference subject if requesting a different prop.
